hero_intro:
Afrobeat. Afro-fusion. Rap.
A sound built on feeling, rhythm and ambition.
artist_bio_1: Eva Diorz is an emerging Nigerian artist exploring the meeting point of Afrobeat, Afro-fusion, Amapiano and rap. Driven by rhythm, honest expression and a love for music, Eva is building a distinct sound and a story that keeps moving forward.
artist_bio_2: Rooted in ambition and inspired by real-life experiences, the music is made to connect, uplift and leave its mark.
release_description: A reminder to keep hope alive, even when life gets heavy. This one is for everyone still pushing forward.
